mapper.select: select tag_value_id , tag_cd , measure_value , string_value , measure_time , datediff(second, lag(measure_time) over(order by measure_time), measure_time) as diff from tb_tag_value where tag_cd = #{tagCd} and measure_time >= dateadd(hour, 8, cast(cast(getdate() as date) as datetime)) and measure_time < dateadd(day, 1, cast(cast(getdate() as date) as datetime)) order by measure_time asc

select c.area_name ,a.equipment_cd ,a.equipment_name ,e.item_cd ,e.item_name ,e.prod_qty ,e.work_proc_id from tb_equipment_mst a join tb_storage_mst b on b.storage_cd = a.storage_cd join tb_area_mst c on c.area_cd = b.area_cd left join ( select a.item_cd ,i.item_name ,a.work_equipment_Cd ,a.prod_qty ,a.work_proc_id from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = a.item_cd where a.proc_cd = 'PRC002' and a.proc_status = '21' and isnull(a.cancel_yn, 'N') = 'N' ) e on e.work_equipment_Cd = a.equipment_cd where a.prod_yn ='Y' and a.use_yn ='Y' ORDER BY b.storage_cd ASC
select tag_cd ,tag_name from tb_tag_info where source = #{tagCd}

SELECT TAG_VALUE_ID ,TAG_CD ,MEASURE_VALUE ,STRING_VALUE ,MEASURE_TIME ,REG_TIME FROM tb_tag_value WHERE (tag_cd = #{tagCd} AND measure_time >= #{strDate} AND measure_time < #{endDate}) ORDER BY measure_time ASC
